title: Returns, Exchanges and Work-Damage Replacement Schedule — SafeStep
content:
# Returns and Replacement Schedule

For each tier of the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program, this schedule gives the window for returning or exchanging unworn items, the period within which footwear damaged at work is replaced without using allowance, and whether a returned purchase restores the employer-paid amount to the participant's allowance.

| Tier | Calendar days after purchase within which unworn items may be returned or exchanged | Days after purchase within which footwear damaged at work is replaced without using allowance | Returned purchase restores the employer-paid amount to the participant's allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 30 | 0 (not offered) | Yes |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 30 | 0 (not offered) | Yes |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 45 | 90 | Yes |
| SafeStep Premier | 45 | 120 | Yes |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 60 | 180 | Yes |

## Conditions of the schedule

- A work-damage figure of 0 means work-damage replacement is not offered on that tier; this is the case on SafeStep Voucher Basic and SafeStep Voucher Plus.
- On every tier a returned purchase restores the employer-paid amount to the participant's allowance.
- The exchange window figure applies to unworn items and is counted in calendar days after the purchase date.

## Quick comparison

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Longest exchange window | 60 calendar days, SafeStep Enterprise |
| Lowest tier offering work-damage replacement | SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear, 90 days |
| Work-damage period on SafeStep Premier | 120 days |
